preview.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished game UI redesign preview of the Fusion Recipe popup shown in image 1, matching the warm chestnut wood and crisp hand-painted 2D MapleStory-inspired cartoon UI style of image 2 and the green buttons in image 3. Image 1 is the EXISTING CONTENT AND LAYOUT reference: keep its wide 1120x720 popup proportion, exactly seven recipe rows, same blue/cyan existing pixel skill icons, first four rows each one visible icon + one black question-mark ingredient = black question-mark result then ??? name; rows five and six have one visible icon + two black question-mark ingredients = result then ???; seventh one visible icon + one black question-mark ingredient = result then ???. Keep aligned ingredient columns at left, equals and result column near center-right, names at right. Preserve the existing small orange X button at top right, same look as image1, do not redesign it. Header centered '조합식'. Native-text-looking cream labels with dark brown outline. Redesign only the skin: medium-dark chestnut wood interior, simple brown wooden frame, NO gold or metallic trim. Tiny green leaves upper-left, compact blue crystal/leaf corner bottom-left and compact orange mushrooms/leaf corner bottom-right. These decorations must be SMALL ENOUGH to never cover seventh row icons: at popup size 1120x720 all bottom corner decorations stay within lowest 65px. Seven rows remain clearly spaced, no large new cells or cards, no new recipe content or labels. ADD pagination at bottom center below all seven rows: a separate small square leaf-green wood-framed left-chevron button, cream page number '1', and matching right-chevron button, visually '< 1 >'. Generous gap between the arrows and central number. Button style matches image3 but SQUARE, around 80x80 each, simple thick cream chevron. No added title plaque or tabs. Show a single isolated popup on charcoal background, landscape image, full board and corners visible. This is a preview; text and buttons will be separate native UI controls in implementation.

assets.name: fusion_popup_board_v1
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached Fusion Recipe popup preview. Extract/redraw ONLY the wide wooden BOARD BACKGROUND as a single production game sprite. Remove all text, Korean title, question marks, skill icons, symbols, numbers, BOTH bottom green navigation buttons, AND orange X button completely. Reconstruct plain uninterrupted wood texture behind all removed elements. Keep the same warm chestnut wood, simple caramel-brown wooden border and crisp dark brown cartoon outlines, no gold or metallic trim. Preserve top-left leaf sprig, bottom-left blue crystal with leaves, bottom-right two tiny orange mushrooms with leaves. Make bottom decorations compact: each cluster stays within bottommost 9 percent of total board height and outermost 15 percent of board width so the last recipe row above remains clear. Reference outer-board ratio about 1.56:1, horizontal. Thin sturdy wood frame about 2.5 percent of board width. Generous uninterrupted opaque wooden interior with no inset slots, separators, cards, plaque, bevel boxes, text or button recesses. All wood is opaque; outside silhouette genuine transparent PNG alpha, never painted checkerboard or gray. Tight canvas with small even transparent margin; full silhouette visible, orthographic front view. This is an individual reusable background asset, not a finished popup or a sheet.

assets.name: fusion_popup_page_button_v1
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Attached image is the Fusion Recipe popup preview. Produce ONE individual blank SQUARE navigation button sprite from its bottom pagination row. Match the same bright leaf-green face, simple warm caramel/chestnut WOOD beveled border with chamfered corners, crisp dark brown cartoon outline. Remove the cream arrow from its center completely and restore plain green underneath. The face has only very subtle leaf texture, generous clean empty green center for a separately rendered native UI chevron. Exact width-height ratio 1:1, symmetric button silhouette and lighting suitable for either left or right control. No letters, numbers, arrow, chevron, symbols, other icons, plaque, popup board, or extra buttons. Single button centered tightly on a square canvas, genuine transparent PNG alpha outside its silhouette, small even transparent margin, opaque interior. No gold or metallic border. Same 2D hand-painted game UI art style as reference. This is a separate reusable production sprite, not a mockup/sheet.
